programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Mithya
programme.desc: Albert Samson, a successful architect, and Alice are leading an unhappy married life because of Samson's ambitious and egoistic nature. Hilda Varghese enters Samson's life and changes it completely.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Chori Mera Kaam
programme.desc: Two petty thieves, Raja and Balu, take refuge in Anjali's house while escaping from the police. When Raja learns about Anjali's misery, he decides to help her.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.desc: In winter, cold and darkness dominate the Arctic Circle, but nature copes astonishingly well. Discover how plants and animals survive these brutal conditions. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Jellyfish: The Ocean's New Rulers
programme.desc: Jellyfish: The Ocean's New Rulers: Jellyfish blooms are on the rise. Could these ancient survivors be reshaping the oceans and challenging life beneath the waves?

programme.title: New: Violent Earth
programme.desc: Hurricane: Experts explore the science behind hurricanes as dramatic footage and survivor stories reveal the devastating power of these deadly storms. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef, facing flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs and killer jellyfish. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters, coming face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish and huge blue whales. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: The trip's final lap visits the land where Australia's desert meets the hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks and manta rays. (3 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Global...
programme.desc: ...Adventure: To celebrate Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday, we look back to when he went on a seven-year journey. From the stunning Great Barrier Reef to the rainforests of Borneo.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Global...
programme.desc: ...Adventure - Home Planet: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him when he embarked on a seven-year journey. From the Great Barrier Reef to the jungles of Borneo.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Global...
programme.desc: ...Adventure: The Rise of Nature. Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he explores life on our planet, starting from seabeds hundreds of millions of years ago to life today.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals
programme.desc: Meet the Jaguars: Head out with Lizzie and the Oncafari team on the hunt for a missing, dominant jaguar - and monitor the battle between young hopefuls who want power. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Ultimate Predator: Stalk the seas with a whitetip reef shark and a pelagic thresher shark, as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: The Hot Springs Pack: Born in Zambia's Luangwa Valley, this litter of wild dogs has a lot to learn if they're to become the crack hunting team the family needs to survive. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Heir to the Clan: The daughter of an alpha female, hyena Spotty is a princess. But in a savagely competitive family, she must cement her status quickly or lose her rank forever. (S2, ep 6)
